name: Assistant provisional native-pixel cattle passage reference rules, before any new model output
source_frame_indexing: 0-based decoded frame order; use original frame IDs and retain packet PTS separately
scope: Focused windows selected from all114 original overview anchors; claims apply only to explicitly reviewed windows
reference_point: Approximate centre of the visible dorsal torso, from behind neck to hip; exclude head, neck, legs and tail. Ambiguous or occluded centres retain an interval and pending status.
stable_observation_times_s: 5Hz: first to third span0.4s; no interpolation of unobserved points
event_time_rule: Third consecutive observed sample in destination region after an established origin region for the same visible animal
clip_boundary_rule: Animals starting in the middle/destination or ending before a destination is established are censored, not complete events
turnaround_rule: A complete reverse traversal can be a second event; do not equate total passages with unique permanent cow identities
human_or_other_non_cattle: Record as noncow control; no cattle passage event
left_pen_cattle: Outside channel centre ROI; excluded from passage population
reference_IDs: Local visually followed reference IDs only; do not claim registered cow identity or link to original detector IDs
uncertainty: Keep candidate event-time brackets, visibility notes and unresolved identity associations; do not fill from later predictions
annotation_authority: assistant-generated provisional annotation from source pixels, requires independent human review
